Package ep.api

Class EnoughProcrastination

java.lang.Object
ep.api.EnoughProcrastination
public class EnoughProcrastination extends Object
Entry point of the application core and the public API of Enough Procrastination.

This facade wires the data store, local storage and the five managers together, loads the saved files once, and exposes the five functions from the Function Specification of the design document with their original string-based signatures:

  1. manageCourse(String, String, String)
  2. manageEvent(String, String, String, String, String, boolean)
  3. planAssignment(String, String, int, int)
  4. filterCalendar(String, String, String)
  5. trackProgress(Assignment, int, boolean)

The GUI uses the typed managers directly (see courses(), events(), assignments(), calendar(), progress()); the string-based functions are thin wrappers over them. Whenever a function returns false, an empty list or -1, the reason can be read with getLastMessage().

Dates use ISO form yyyy-MM-dd, times use HH:mm, and a date range is written yyyy-MM-dd..yyyy-MM-dd (either side may be left out).

  • Method Details

    • manageCourse

      public boolean manageCourse(String actionType, String name, String color)
      Adds, edits or deletes a course.
      • "add": creates a course with name and color.
      • "edit": finds the course called name and gives it the new color. (Renaming is done with CourseManager.editCourse(String, String, String).)
      • "delete": removes the course called name; linked events and assignments stay and become unlinked.
      Parameters:
      actionType - "add", "edit" or "delete"
      name - course name; must be non-blank and unique when adding
      color - color in #RRGGBB form (may be blank for the default)
      Returns:
      true if the change was saved

    • manageEvent

      public boolean manageEvent(String actionType, String title, String date, String startTime, String endTime, boolean isAllDay)
      Adds, edits or deletes a fixed event. For "edit" and "delete" the event is identified by title and date; an edit replaces its time with the given values.
      Parameters:
      actionType - "add", "edit" or "delete"
      title - non-blank title
      date - day in yyyy-MM-dd form
      startTime - start in HH:mm form (ignored when all-day)
      endTime - end in HH:mm form, after the start (ignored when all-day)
      isAllDay - true for an all-day event
      Returns:
      true if the change was saved

    • planAssignment

      public List<StudyBlock> planAssignment(String title, String dueDate, int totalHours, int blockLength)
      Creates an assignment and plans its study blocks backward from the deadline. If the free time is short, only the blocks that fit are placed and getLastMessage() carries the shortage warning (hasWarning() becomes true).
      Parameters:
      title - non-blank title
      dueDate - deadline in yyyy-MM-dd form, today or later
      totalHours - estimated hours, at least 1
      blockLength - preferred block length in hours
      Returns:
      the scheduled blocks, or an empty list if the input was invalid

    • filterCalendar

      public List<CalendarItem> filterCalendar(String keyword, String courseName, String dateRange)
      Searches all saved events and study blocks.
      Parameters:
      keyword - word that must appear in the title, or blank
      courseName - name of the course to filter by, or blank
      dateRange - yyyy-MM-dd, from..to, from.. or ..to; blank for any date
      Returns:
      the matching items in calendar order (empty when nothing matches)
